description:
F4 portable Bluetooth speaker 5W is a compact wireless speaker made for loud, punchy music in small rooms, desks, and travel setups. With Bluetooth 5.0 and a 10m range, it pairs fast and stays stable, so your playlist doesn’t stutter during calls, reels, or workouts. The sporty car-shaped design turns heads on your study table or office desk, while the stereo output keeps vocals clear and beats lively.

No internet? No problem. Pop in a microSD card for direct music playback or switch to the built-in FM radio for quick entertainment. From hostel rooms to house parties and road trips, this mini speaker brings “thunder” style sound in a pocket-friendly size—perfect as a gift or your daily music buddy.
